Problem Statement
Read a number N and print the sum of all the numbers from 1 to N that are not multiples of 3.
Description
Read a positive integer N. Find the sum of all the numbers from 1 to N (including N) that are not multiples of 3, and print the sum.
Input Description
A single integer N. (1 <= N <= 1000)
Output Description
Print the sum as a single integer.
Sample Input
6

12
